name: One-Man-Crew
tagline: Lost-item matching by text and image similarity, with staff confirming ownership before anything is returned.

awards: SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité

problem: Students struggle to recover lost items even when someone has found them; the builder lost a meaningful gift.
solution: Text and image embeddings rank the five closest found items; staff review them, ask clarifying questions and confirm ownership manually.
demo_moment: Team-described: file a report and review the ranked matches as staff.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “SAP - Sponsor Challenge // SAP - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Keeps a person in the loop for the ownership decision.

lessons: Let the model rank and the human decide.
